import {Link, Post} from "./Post"; import welcome from "./assets/welcome.png"; const months = "january february march april may june july august september november december".split(" ") const now = new Date(); function today() { return `${months[now.getMonth()]} ${now.getDate()}, ${now.getFullYear()}` } export const WelcomePost = (

Hey there! I'm Michael Liu. Below is a catalog of all the projects I've worked on since around February 2024!


I'll try to post here regularly. If I make a blog post a month, I'll have achieved my goal. If I make a blog post a week, then I'll probably get hired somewhere.


The goal of this blog isn't to get hired, though! I just want to be able to look back on these projects and see the trajectory of my growth over these years, as it's something I've regretted not doing.


Well, what are you waiting for? Take a look at my cool stuff!


Computer Graphics:

  • a 3d renderer in 2d desmos
  • wip: my custom game engine
  • halftoning with glsl

Programming Languages:
  • tōsuto: a scripting language

)
